title: Connect / serialisation / invocation authority
summary: Connect Selector authorizes and selects direct, RPC or Queue Fabric; Serialisation Selector selects codecs/schema; RpcServiceDispatcher performs service-object method invocation; protocol bindings parse and construct JSON-RPC, SOAP or gRPC envelopes. These are separate version and policy authorities.
invariants: Route selection is not inferred from a content type or method string.
Codec selection never implies durability, identity, retries or dispatch permission.
A protocol adapter must not create a second registry of directly invokable ooRexx methods.
No automatic failover/retry after ambiguous completion of effectful calls.
A callback sink is not an exported remotely invokable object.
